set.body: PRD C-1..C-3. Compare[-A,-B,+S] heterogeneous, returning Either[CompareError, S]. CompareError subsumes EstimateError, GridMismatch, FrameMismatch. Every measure declares a MeasureScale and ships under the interface it ACTUALLY satisfies: cosine is not a Metric; 1/(1+W1) is not a Metric; entropic Sinkhorn has d(x,x) > 0; MultiMatch's median aggregate breaks the triangle inequality. Each stated in Scaladoc.
